# TahCabs

> On-demand cab and bike booking with live driver tracking.

TahCabs lets riders book cars and bikes, track drivers live on a map, and pay after the trip. Drivers can register, get verified, and accept ride requests in real time.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Book a ride, see nearby drivers, get fare estimates.
- [Sign in](/login): Rider and driver sign-in.
- [Register](/register): Create a new rider account.
- [Become a driver](/become-driver): Apply to drive on TahCabs.
